The '''Wine Riots''' took place in the [[Rahad]], a section of [[Ebou Dar]]. {{ref/book|5|48}} The use of soldiers in the Rahad either caused or exacerbated the situation, to the point that [[Tylin]] would not send them there again.{{ref|{{twotc}}, Wine Riots (of Ebou Dar)}}
